changelog: Refined numeral handling: added an exception that penalizes markers that split a numeral from an immediately adjacent measurement/unit token (low target band 10–35) to address measured over-trust on numeric+unit splits (traceable to critique case list).

Added targeted down-weighting for markers immediately after short named/org/id tokens (reduce target band 15–45 unless the opposite side contains an independent numeral/date/unit), to correct over-boosting at short-name boundaries (traceable to critique cases).
Updated surface-form checklist and examples to reflect the two targeted downgrades and show concrete applied effects in sample outputs.
